The missing left strip must be real solid matching shadowed taupe hair, not transparency, not a line tracing the old cut, not a separate detached shard. Make the dark mauve shadow and pale taupe highlight continuous across the old diagonal cut so the cut is no longer visible. Thin brown outer outline, mother-like cel shading, no additional curls or spiral. Keep the lower tips near their original bottom y950 and retain the RIGHT outline exactly. Do not enlarge, recenter, rotate, mirror or lengthen the lock. Keep this same 1024x1024 composition with genuine alpha transparency and all other space empty. Output only one completed single ponytail component, no character/body/face/hand/bow, no diagram/text/magenta/checkerboard.
